ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Power Loss: The power ring needs periodic recharging and issues a warning as its power runs low. Reputation: Guy Gardner is hard-nosed and stubborn. People usually expect the worst from Guy... and they usually get it. Weakness: Green Lantern power rings depend on the willpower of the wearer; the maximum rank of the ring’s effects is equal to the wearer’s Will rank, and moments of self-doubt or hesitation can cause the ring to fail.
